covered.label: National Rail (ScotRail and others)
covered.detail: Every train calling at Perth, Inverness, Aberdeen and Dundee, and this region's other stations, from the UK's national real-time feed.

notCovered.label: Caledonian Sleeper
notCovered.detail: Excluded at Aberdeen, Inverness, Fort William and Mallaig — booking a berth is compulsory.

stations: Nine stations. Perth, Inverness, Aberdeen and Dundee are all hubs — none ranks above the others.
notes: This region covers Aberdeen, Inverness, Dundee and the Highlands — Glasgow and Edinburgh are separate regions. Its hub station 'Perth' is in Scotland, not Western Australia's Perth, which is also in this app.
